title: Country Programme Outcome Evaluation: Climate Resilience in Kenya
executive_summary: This evaluation assesses UNDP's climate resilience programming in Kenya (2019-2023). Key findings: 15,000 smallholder farmers trained in climate-smart agriculture; 80% adoption rate in pilot areas. Recommendations focus on scaling mechanization support and strengthening early warning systems.

title: Thematic Evaluation: Gender and Women Empowerment in Sub-Saharan Africa
executive_summary: Analysis of 45 gender-focused projects across 12 African countries. Notable outcomes: 250,000 women entrepreneurs supported; increased participation in local governance from 18% to 34%. Cost per beneficiary: $250. Recommendations: enhance partnerships with women's organizations and integrate gender into mainline programming.

title: Project Evaluation: Governance Strengthening Initiative - Bangladesh
executive_summary: Evaluation of 3-year governance project strengthening sub-national institutions. Results: 450 local government officials trained; 25 district governance committees established. Community trust in local government increased 22%. Key lesson: sustained technical support critical for institutionalization.

title: Country Programme Outcome Evaluation: Brazil Green Infrastructure
executive_summary: Assessment of green infrastructure initiatives in three Brazilian states. Coverage: 150,000 hectares of restored mangroves and forests. Co-benefits: 5,000 jobs created in conservation/restoration. Biodiversity index improved 18%. Financial sustainability mechanisms need strengthening.

title: Joint Evaluation: UNDP-GIZ Resilience Programming in the Sahel
executive_summary: Joint UNDP-GIZ evaluation of crisis response and resilience-building in Sahel. Achievements: $12M leveraged from donors; 450,000 people reached with livelihood support. Community savings groups: 850 established with 18,000 members (60% women). Challenges: security constraints; recommendation for adaptive programming.
